title: Wendell and the Colony
author: Astrid Montrose
blurb: Quentin Eriksen, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
